title: Tool Info
description: Adds stats to certain tools that show you how much blocks you broke.
body:
This mod adds the amount of blocks you broke to mostly all the tools that can break blocks:

every tool has its own stat, so you can see exactly how many blocks that specific pickaxe, shovel, axe, or other tool has broken.

- Pickaxe
- Shovel
- Axe
- Hoe
- Shears

i might add a stat for tools for how many mobs/players you killed with that tool.
